name: -6 AN Fitting Bulkhead Nut
title: -6 AN Fitting Bulkhead Nut
description:
The -6 AN Fitting Bulkhead Nut is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings AN Bulkhead Lock Nuts are precision CNC-machined to securely fasten AN bulkhead fittings through firewalls, chassis panels, fuel cells, and custom fabrication projects. Designed to provide a tight, vibration-resistant hold, these bulkhead nuts ensure proper alignment and a secure mounting surface for leak-free AN plumbing systems.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: Premium high-grade construction with corrosion-resistant coating.
